title: Agentive AI Trader
author: Sagintel
selftext:
Meet #TREDA, an open-source, multi-agentive AI trader built for the #Deriv broker that operates 24/7. #TREDA doesn't just cross moving averages,it reads charts, enumerates paths, debates internally, and evolves its own strategies. I’ve open-sourced the entire #codebase. check out the repository, fork it,contribute,etc....... then run the daemon, and experiment
